items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Cat Anderson was with that band, out of Jenkins Orphanage in South Carolina.

ctx.x: I got to hear a lot of music! A lot of different bands, like Jeter-Philips out of St. Louis, and Don Albert out of San Antonio, Texas... Oh, all kind of bands, territorial bands that I had the opportunity to hear. The Carolina Cotton Pickers; Cat Anderson was with that band, out of Jenkins Orphanage in South Carolina. And all kind of bands. Joe Robicheaux out of New Orleans. Henry
